name: ellipsoid
why: Non-uniform scale in the exact kernel, against a closed form: the ellipsoid of semi-axes 20, 10, 5 is 4188.790 mm3. The backend refuses unless the B-rep volume equals the child's times the determinant, which is also what caught BRepGProp's fixed-order integration misreading B-spline faces (an elliptic cylinder by 0.86%); Shape::signed_volume integrates adaptively since. The mesh volume recorded here sits a tessellation under the closed form, as the plain sphere's does.
